The VERO experience

Less interruption. Better decisions.

VERO is built around the moment a call arrives, the context that helps you decide, and the follow-up that should not require another round of tapping.

01 · Ready when you are

Your calling day at a glance

The VERO home screen keeps high-frequency actions close without turning the app into a dashboard. Frequent contacts, focus modes and call readiness stay visible in a calm, compact workspace.

Focus mode can handle calls for a selected period using a chosen response such as Driving, Meeting or Busy. Once the timer ends, VERO returns to normal call handling automatically.

02 · Call with context

Say why before the call begins

Before calling another VERO user, the caller can optionally choose a short, predefined reason. The call button remains available at all times, so adding context never becomes a barrier to making a normal call.

Reason templates are deliberately structured rather than free-form. That keeps delivery fast, supports relevant quick replies and reduces the risk of unwanted content reaching the incoming-call screen.

03 · Understand the interruption

A reason and useful replies on arrival

When both people use VERO, the receiver can see the caller’s selected reason before answering. The screen keeps Accept and Reject prominent while presenting quick replies that match the reason.

If the receiver cannot talk, a quick reply can resolve the question and decline the call in one step. “Delivered through VERO” describes the delivery channel; it does not imply that the caller is trusted, paid or exempt from spam controls.

04 · Calls and contacts

One place to call, message and remember

Recents identify call direction, time and the SIM used for the call. Contacts remain synchronized with Android’s contact provider, so a contact added or updated on the phone can appear in VERO without maintaining a separate cloud contact book.

Expanded actions make SMS, WhatsApp, WhatsApp Business and Telegram available only when the corresponding app is installed. Call reminders stay on the device and can alert through the system ringtone, vibration or both.

05 · Start anywhere

Dial once, choose the right channel

The dial screen supports Android’s familiar number editing actions and keeps calling central. When messaging is more appropriate, VERO can hand the number to SMS or an installed supported messaging app.

Dual-SIM devices can present the available routes near the Call action. On a single-SIM phone, VERO avoids an unnecessary selector and uses the available network automatically.

VERO messaging

Messages organised by purpose

VERO’s messaging experience adds practical classification and notification controls while retaining Android’s SMS provider as the device history.

Inbox · Sent · Intent mute

See what matters, quiet what does not

VERO classifies common message purposes such as transactional, service updates, marketing and government announcements. Threads can also be corrected manually when automated classification does not match the user’s expectation.

Intent mute lets the user suppress selected categories without deleting the messages. Sent messages remain available from the device SMS provider, and notification choices remain under the user’s Android settings.

Privacy and transparency

Clear about what stays local and what connects.

VERO is designed to use device data only for the calling and messaging functions the user requests. It does not build a crowd-sourced global caller directory.

Contacts and call historyRead from Android’s providers for caller names, recents and calling workflows. VERO does not upload the user’s address book as a contact database.
Local spam intelligenceUser spam reports, reputation rules, settings and reminders are designed to remain on the device unless a future feature clearly asks for separate consent.
Connected VERO featuresPhone verification, account status, push delivery and VERO-to-VERO call reasons use Firebase and VERO’s secured server infrastructure.
Permissions remain optionalAndroid permission and default-app choices are presented for the features that require them. Some functions are unavailable when their required role or permission is declined.
This page describes the current product direction and is not a substitute for the final Play Store privacy policy. The formal policy will identify retention, deletion, service providers and contact details before public distribution.

Questions, feedback or account help

Contact VERO

Use the support form for product feedback, testing questions, privacy enquiries or an account-deletion request.

Open support form

Request account deletion

Open the VERO support form and enter “Account deletion request” in the message. Include only the information requested by the form. VERO will verify account ownership before permanently deleting the account and associated server-side data, except information that must be retained for security, fraud prevention or legal obligations.
